name: pr-lamp
description: The current branch's pull request as a lamp: checks, review, unresolved threads and what is left before it can merge, in the status line and a /pr pane; a toast when it changes, and red checks and new review comments fed to Claude beside the next prompt

feed.title: Feed Claude
feed.description: Attach checks turning red, new review comments and new conflicts to the next prompt typed at an idle prompt; on by default
